items.reason: A rinse-off 2% salicylic cleanser is a gentler way to smooth the look of texture on oily skin.
A ceramide moisturizer helps keep sensitive skin comfortable while it adjusts to exfoliating.
A mineral SPF 50 is a gentle daily choice for fair, sensitive skin and is needed alongside exfoliating products.

response.routine_note: I removed the 30% peel because it is a very strong first step for skin that scans as oily and sensitive, so start with the gentler salicylic cleanser a few evenings a week and build up only if your skin stays comfortable. Follow with moisturizer, and wear the SPF every morning.
